name: hud_ui_element_invalidate
description: HudUiElement::Invalidate ORs the global HUD invalidation mask into the element flags.
known_limits: tier S verification remains pending for the HudUiElement common source cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4b4180 ORs g_HudUi_InvalidateMask into self->flags and returns.
Native smoke zhud_element_clip_and_invalidate_smoke sets g_HudUi_InvalidateMask to 0x24, starts an element with flags 0x01, calls Invalidate, and verifies the flags become 0x25.
